targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-592f (2026-06-01, controlled state-machine probe; supersedes V3-EXQ-592e; FAIL_NO_RELEASE_AUTHORITY): with beta forced already elevated and E3 committed pointer forced present, forced score_margin=0.01 (below floor 0.05) and forced nav_readiness=0.0 (below floor 0.3) produce zero state-occupancy suppression and zero decommit transitions across stages B/C/D. nav readiness predicate IS consulted (n_blocks_emitted advances 6 per stage in C/D); score_margin admission gate is bypassed because beta is already elevated (current bistable-branch design). C4 conjunction-authority returns PASS vacuously (0 >= max(0, 0)); diagnostic outcome correctly ignores it because C2 AND C3 AND C5 FAIL. NOT a falsification of MECH-090 base claim (EXQ-049e remains the canonical PASS). NOT a falsification of R-c admission integration (V3-EXQ-592d retains its 4-arm validation scope on the admission axis). IS a controlled-measurement confirmation of the 592e autopsy: current R-c integration is admission-only; the same predicates that guard entry do not currently couple to beta_gate.release() or e3._committed_trajectory clearing under failure-while-elevated. Architectural choice routed via implement-substrate AMEND on the MECH-090 substrate_queue entry: option (a) add a readiness-failure-while-elevated release coupling, or option (b) document admission-only as the architectural commitment and audit hippocampal-completion / urgency-interrupt / V_s anchor / SD-034 closure pathways for coverage of degraded-readiness scenarios.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Architectural choice from V3-EXQ-592f autopsy (user-confirmed 2026-06-02): option (b) ADMISSION-ONLY + AUDIT, with conditional follow-on chain (see conditional_chain field; full prose in failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-592f_2026-06-02.md Section 9.1). Document admission-only as the architectural commitment for MECH-090 R-c readiness conjunction. Audit the four existing release pathways for coverage of degraded-readiness scenarios -- single concrete question per pathway: 'Does this pathway fire when nav_competence has been low for K consecutive ticks while beta_gate.is_elevated?' (1) ARC-028 / MECH-105 hippocampal-completion. (2) MECH-091 urgency-interrupt -- z_harm_a.norm() threshold only fires on threat escalation, not readiness decay. (3) V_s anchor invalidation (MECH-269 / MECH-284 / MECH-287 broadcast) -- does sustained low readiness register as anchor staleness? (4) SD-034 closure operator -- mode-conditioned at sd_033a write_gate >= min; orthogonal to readiness. Branch B1 (audit clears): no new substrate work; resolve 592f failure_record + clear pending_retest_after_substrate. Branch B2 (gap + pathway-resident fix on the existing biology map): open / amend substrate_queue on the failing pathway, not on MECH-090. Branch B3 (gap exceeds existing biology coverage): commission /lit-pull at the disambiguating biology question; lit-pull output then routes to B3a (existing pathway absorbs new biology), B3b (new substrate_queue entry on previously unclaimed mechanism -- the only branch where option (a) new R-c-level release coupling can resurface, and only if biology supports it), or B3c (substrate_ceiling / substrate_conditional / V4 reclassification). NOT taken at audit-entry: option (a) new R-c-level release coupling as default. Successor: no new MECH-090 substrate work this lineage; pending_retest_after_substrate flag on the 592f manifest is gated on the audit + (optional) lit-pull + (optional) follow-on substrate work landing, depending on which branch fires.

failure_record_entry.metric: Predicates fire under forced beta-elevated state but produce zero state-occupancy suppression (b/c/d_supp.max_drop = 0.0); diagnostic outcome FAIL_NO_RELEASE_AUTHORITY. nav_blocks advance 6 per stage in C/D (predicate consulted) but no transition counter ever ticked. score_blocks=0 in B/D because BetaGate.should_admit_elevation is bypassed when beta already elevated.
failure_record_entry.target: User-confirmed routing (2026-06-02): option (b) admission-only + audit of existing release pathways (ARC-028/MECH-105 hippocampal completion, MECH-091 urgency interrupt, V_s anchor invalidation, SD-034 closure operator) for coverage of degraded-readiness scenarios. NOT taken: option (a) new R-c-level release coupling.

learning_extracted: MECH-090 R-c readiness predicates are admission-side only by current implementation; controlled forcing in 592f cleanly observes the consequence (zero release authority over already-held committed state).

Score-margin and nav-competence predicates fire on different sites: score-margin gate is bypassed entirely when beta already elevated (only consulted on the admission transition); nav-competence increments n_blocks_emitted but has no release-side consumer.

User-confirmed architectural response (2026-06-02): option (b) admission-only + audit of existing release pathways. Option (a) new R-c-level release coupling NOT taken. Audit targets: ARC-028/MECH-105 hippocampal-completion, MECH-091 urgency-interrupt, V_s anchor invalidation (MECH-269/284/287), SD-034 closure operator.

C4 conjunction-authority criterion in the 592f script admits a vacuous PASS at identically-zero suppression (d_supp.max_drop=0 >= max(b_supp,c_supp)=0). User-confirmed routing: in-place script patch via /queue-experiment (require d_supp.max_drop strictly > 0 AND >= max(b_supp,c_supp)); not edited in this autopsy session per mandatory-skill-path rule.

MECH-090 base claim (beta gates E3-to-action-selection propagation, not E3 internal updating) is INTACT. R-c admission integration is INTACT. V3-EXQ-592d behavioural validation on the admission axis remains live.

branches.label: audit_clears
branches.condition: One of the four pathways already covers degraded-readiness mid-commitment.
branches.response: No new substrate work. Resolve 592f failure_record with 'covered by <pathway>'. Clear pending_retest_after_substrate on the 592f manifest.

branches.label: gap_with_pathway_resident_fix
branches.condition: Audit finds a gap AND the failing pathway's existing biology coverage (already-commissioned lit-pulls) extends to the readiness-decay regime.
branches.response: Open or amend substrate_queue entry on the failing pathway (NOT on MECH-090). Audit session transitions into the pathway-resident substrate work.

branches.label: gap_exceeds_biology_coverage
branches.condition: Audit finds a gap AND either (i) the failing pathway's existing lit-pull does not reach the degraded-readiness regime, or (ii) no pathway looks like a natural home.
branches.response: Commission /lit-pull targeted at the disambiguating biology question. Lit-pull output routes to one of B3a / B3b / B3c.
branches.lit_pull_topic_hint: motor-program-cessation under readiness decay; thalamic / STN beta-decay / cortical PE-spike vs sustained-readiness-failure release mechanisms in BG-STN-thalamic loops

sub_branches.label: existing_pathway_absorbs_new_biology
sub_branches.response: Collapses to B2 with the new lit context attached.

sub_branches.label: new_substrate_on_unclaimed_mechanism
sub_branches.response: Open a new substrate_queue entry on the unclaimed mechanism. This is the only branch under which option (a) 'new R-c-level release coupling on MECH-090' can resurface as a defensible choice -- and only if the post-lit-pull biology specifically supports release living at the R-c level rather than elsewhere.

sub_branches.label: substrate_ceiling_or_v4_reclassification
sub_branches.response: Governance accepts substrate_ceiling / substrate_conditional / V4 reclassification of the reach axis. No V3 code work.

conditional_chain.pending_retest_after_substrate_resolutio: Flag stays TRUE on the 592f manifest until the audit (+ optional lit-pull + optional follow-on substrate work) lands on a definite branch. Cleared by B1 audit closure, B2 pathway-resident substrate work, B3a same, B3b new-substrate-entry landing, or B3c governance reclassification.
